info.name: Azure Event Hubs Data Plane REST Authorization Rules Events API

params.name: eventHubPath
params.description: The path to the event hub.

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for the request.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Timeout for the REST operation in seconds. The value is between 1 and 120 seconds.

items.docs: Sends a new event to an event hub. The event body can be any content type. Custom user properties can be set via the UserProperties header.

info.name: Azure Event Hubs Send batch events

params.name: eventHubPath
params.description: The path to the event hub.

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for the request.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Timeout for the REST operation in seconds. The value is between 1 and 120 seconds.

items.docs: Sends a new batched message event to an Event Hub. Batching reduces the number of messages that are transmitted by merging information from multiple messages into a single batch of messages. The message body must be a valid JSON array payload following the convention to describe each message. The Content-Type header must be set to application/vnd.microsoft.servicebus.json.

info.name: Azure Event Hubs Send partition event

params.name: eventHubPath
params.description: The path to the event hub.

params.name: partitionId
params.description: The ID of a partition on an event hub.

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for the request.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Timeout for the REST operation in seconds. The value is between 1 and 120 seconds.

items.docs: Sends a new event to a specified partition in an Event Hub. This allows you to target a specific partition for the event rather than letting Event Hubs distribute it.

info.name: Azure Event Hubs Send event with publisher ID

params.name: eventHubPath
params.description: The path to the event hub.

params.name: api-version
params.description: The API version to use for the request.

params.name: timeout
params.description: Timeout for the REST operation in seconds. The value is between 1 and 120 seconds.

items.docs: Sends a new event to an Event Hub with a specified publisher ID. This enables publisher identity tracking and publisher policy enforcement on the event hub.
